newsitem.title: USA: Micron Electronics cuts server prices.
newsitem.headline: Micron Electronics cuts server prices.

text.p: Micron Electronics Inc said Wednesday it had cut prices on its Vetix EL computer servers by up to $400 to maintain its competitive edge in the growing business marketplace.

"Lowering our prices on both the Vetix EL 1000 series and the Vetix EL 2000 series will make us even more affordable for small and medium-sized businesses," Brian Klene, executive vice president of sales and marketing, said in a statement.

Micron Electronics, principally owned by Micron Technology Inc, said the Vetix EL 1000N, which comes equipped with networking software, has been reduced to $4,099 from $4,499, and the EL 1000N (B) has been cut to $4,599 from $4,999.
The Vetix EL 2000N (A) was reduced to $4,899 from $5,299, the EL 2000N (B) to $5,399 from $5,799, and the EL2000N to $6,499 from $6,999.
